function.name: update_state_intake
function.description: Call this whenever the caller provides any new intake information. Requires the requestID returned by get_new_requestID. Only include fields the caller has actually stated in this turn — omit anything not yet known. Call it multiple times as more information comes in over the conversation, not just once at the end.

requestID.description: The id returned by get_new_requestID for this service request

county.description: Which of Summit Air's three service counties the address is in

issue_description.description: What the caller said is wrong with their HVAC system
